new_production_study.limits: Section11 explicitly identifies client-side traces and no server-side view. Tool wall-clock includes CPU/IO and is not CPU utilization, billed cloud core-hours, or CPU purchase value. Neither all activity residing in new datacenter sockets nor any particular Intel share follows. No quality signals; retry and scheduling improvements can change work per successful task.
new_production_study.bull_relevance: Observed production behavior strengthens the value of CPU-side latency and memory. It does not select an industry TAM, elasticities, Intel unit growth, or premium ASP.

interpretation: A wide range of published TAM forecasts does not prove the Intel forecast conservative or aggressive without matching merchant, captive, bundled-CPU allocation, date, pricing and share definitions. Do not average these forecasts or assign equal likelihood. Future role-specific performance and customer economics determine capture.
